headlines.title: Federal Reserve keeps interest rates unchanged in final vote before midterms
headlines.description: The Federal Reserve has voted to keep interest rates unchanged despite rising inflation. NBC News' Brian Chueng reports on the central bank's final rate decision before the midterm elections.

headlines.title: Labor rights icon Dolores Huerta dies at 96
headlines.description: Dolores Huerta, who co-founded the United Farm Workers union with Cesar Chavez, spent decades fighting for marginalized communities and inspired generations with her rallying cry “Sí se puede.” NBC News’ Liz Kreutz reports.

headlines.title: RFK Jr. takes shortcut to make some unapproved peptides available for use
headlines.description: HHS is pausing legal action against compounding pharmacies that make certain peptides, effectively allowing them to offer the unapproved drugs immediately.

headlines.title: Study estimates 75% of NFL players who died over 15-year span had CTE
headlines.description: An estimated 75% of professional football players who died over a 15-year span had signs of chronic traumatic encephalopathy, or CTE, a study published Wednesday found. It’s the highest estimate to date.

headlines.title: Early midterm voting data shows enthusiasm ahead of election day
headlines.description: With millions of Americans having already voted, NBC News Director of Elections John Lapinski analyzes early midterm voting data and key races to watch on election night.

headlines.title: Hayden Panettiere’s death is ruled accidental and police investigation is closed
headlines.description: Panettiere, 36, died of the toxic effects of multiple drugs, including fentanyl, the coroner determined.

headlines.title: Meet the Democrats trying to flip the script on gun rights: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: Welcome to From the Politics Desk, a daily newsletter that brings you the NBC News Politics team’s latest reporting and analysis from the White House, Capitol Hill and the campaign trail.

headlines.title: Ex-fiancé in ‘The People’s Court’ disappearance charged with murder after phone data review
headlines.description: Dale Smith Jr., of Orlando, Florida, was arrested this month and charged with the second-degree murder of Michelle Parker.

headlines.title: Chiefs coach defends signing kicker suspended after sexual misconduct allegations
headlines.description: Justin Tucker, 37, hasn’t played in the NFL since 2024. Coach Andy Reid said the team did “our homework” before it added him.

headlines.title: Fed plans to eliminate some rate-setting meetings, chairman says
headlines.description: The Federal Reserve plans to eliminate some meetings devoted to setting interest rates in the next couple of years, Chairman Kevin Warsh said Wednesday.

headlines.title: Federal Reserve leaves interest rates unchanged despite rising inflation
headlines.description: The soaring costs of gas, diesel and crude oil are a major driver of higher prices across the U.S. economy.

headlines.title: Hasan Piker files $72.5 million defamation suit against Scott Jennings
headlines.description: The progressive pundit claims the conservative commentator deliberately distorted his remarks to falsely portray him as a supporter of lynching Black people.
